name: remuxing-to-mov
description: Losslessly remux broadcast and web video (.ts, .mpg/.vob, .mkv, broken .mov) into a QuickTime-ready .mov without re-encoding. One-command /mov shortcut; escalation ladder (copy → PCM audio → genpts → gap-collapse resync → timeline repair routed by timestamp profile: pair-mate PTS fill or elementary rebuild → operator-attested re-encode via rung4.sh only); keep-all audio default (every track survives, movenc enables exactly one — TN3177 without curation; --audio auto decides per kept track: QT-native copies bit-exact, the rest become announced PCM access conversions; language-aware layouts curation; pcm_bluray/pcm_dvd HDMV LPCM routed to PCM access — the copy-muxed track is undecodable; --drc dynamic-range control; dual-track PCM-access + bit-exact-original audio only when QuickTime needs it); evidence-demoted gates (4:2:2 contribution profiles build with an advisory and a post-build empirical playability check that self-dates its macOS — REVIEW on fail or unverified platform; mpegts timeline rot warns pre-build and verify judges the artifact; still refused at every entry point: VC-1/VP9/AV1 video and Dolby E audio, exit 11 with routed alternatives); 200M probe windows with a 1G retry (ffmpeg's 5M default is dimension-blind on real captures); SOURCE DAMAGED keyed to transport evidence, never decode noise; mid-GOP starts auto-trimmed at the first IDR (trim-to-idr.sh, --no-idr-trim to skip); measured native-codec matrix (mp4v/MJPEG-420/DV/ProRes; unproven codecs land REVIEW, never an unproven DONE); field-coded (PAFF) repair including the half-timestamped pair class; muxer-confession hard stop; resync refuses mid-stream audio-layout-change sources (silence-injection class); one-command ts-health capture scan (transport loss, missing timestamps, gaps/rot, 33-bit PTS wrap, mid-GOP start — every finding routed to its lossless fix); whole-file timeline, presentation-order, scrub, A/V-parity, audio-playability, and silence content-parity verification gates with source-gap-budget tolerance, operator-attested waiver sidecars, and a master-purity scan; opt-in qt-groups.sh QuickTime language-menu post-pass; normalized exit-code contract with machine-readable lines at every stage; per-file fidelity proof (playable-check.sh --fidelity: after the thumbnail floor, bounded avconvert ProRes windows of the same moments SSIM-compared, yuv444p-normalized, against the ffmpeg reference decode — renders ≠ renders correctly; RTM_FIDELITY_SSIM threshold, default 0.90, below → verdict=fail reason=fidelity; additive PLAYCHECK_FIDELITY line and fidelity=ok|fail|skip on MOV_PLAYABILITY; drivers pass it automatically on 4:2:2 contribution builds); m2v1→xd5* retag advisory (QuickTime glitching on MPEG-2 4:2:2 m2v1 that FFmpeg players decode clean is decoder dispatch, not damage; a lossless -c copy -tag:v xd5b retag routes to the pro XDCAM HD422 decoder, CBR unenforced; probe prints the advisory plus additive PR_TAG_ADVICE=xd5b on the m2v1+4:2:2+MOV class only; advisory-only — auto-apply deferred pending bench); movie-timescale overflow pre-announce (chapter warning onset measured at 2^31 movie-timescale ticks ≈49.7 min at the broadcast-common 720000 LCM, finer LCMs sooner, -video_track_timescale cannot move it; geometry-gated chapter-track drop past 2^32 ticks suppresses its own warning, so mov/resync announce up front — RTM_CHAPTER_TS_WARN_SECS/RTM_CHAPTER_TS_DROP_SECS tiers, additive MOV_CHAPTER_TS_WARN line, -map_chapters -1 escape hatch — announced, never silent); post-hoc gap-collapse repair route (an already-collapsed MOV — video timeline keeping forward gaps, contiguous audio short by a sizable fraction of the summed gaps — repairs with resync.sh --all-audio --pcm 32, routed by diagnose's DISCONTINUOUS SOURCE verdict as the second broken-.mov recovery route beside rebuild-paff.sh); opt-in QuickTime metadata. The source file is never touched; every codec/container fact re-verified on a named bench in a claims registry that records its own reversals.
